description:
Update an agent's configuration — name, description, voice settings, instructions, greeting, call transfer, or voicemail. Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields keep their current value.
Switching voice_mode to 'hosted' requires a system_prompt.
Returns the agent's full configuration after the update.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to update, from list_agents.

ambient_sound.description: Optional background ambience for call audio. Not a substitute for AI self-identification; this connector adds disclosure only to outbound calls placed through its call tools.

begin_message.description: What the AI says when a call connects (hosted mode only). If omitted, the current greeting is left unchanged.

denoising_mode.description: Audio denoising. The aggressive mode helps callers in cars/cafes (small surcharge).

description.description: A short note describing what this agent is for; for your reference only.

enable_backchannel.description: Whether the agent interjects 'uh-huh'/'mhmm' while the caller speaks. Default true.

enable_messaging.description: Whether a hosted agent can send and read texts during a call. Default true.

interruption_sensitivity.description: How readily the agent lets a caller interrupt it — lower values make it harder to cut off, higher values stop it at the first sound.

language.description: BCP-47 locale for speech recognition and synthesis, e.g. 'en-US', 'es-ES', 'ja-JP'.

max_silence_ms.description: How long the agent waits through continuous caller silence before ending the call. Omit to keep the agent's current timeout.

model_tier.description: Model quality/speed tier for hosted-mode agents. 'turbo' = fastest/cheapest, 'balanced' = general use, 'max' = highest quality, 'realtime' = speech-to-speech, lowest latency.

name.description: A new label for the agent, shown in listings and account views.

stt_mode.description: Speech-to-text mode: 'fast' lowest latency, 'accurate' for exact names/numbers (~200ms slower).

system_prompt.description: The AI's personality and instructions. Required when voice_mode is 'hosted'.

transfer_number.description: Phone number to transfer calls to (E.164 format), or empty string to remove.

voice.description: A voice ID from list_voices to set for the agent.

voice_mode.description: Whether calls are handled by your webhook (transcripts forwarded to your URL) or by the built-in hosted AI (driven by system_prompt).

voice_speed.description: How fast the agent speaks, as a multiplier of normal pace (1 is normal, below 1 is slower, above 1 is faster). If omitted, the current speed is unchanged.

voicemail_message.description: Voicemail greeting text, or empty string to disable voicemail.
